description: Iconic UNESCO World Heritage historic wharf featuring colorful wooden commercial buildings.
The world's largest sculpture park created by a single artist, showcasing over 200 works by Gustav Vigeland.
Northernmost medieval cathedral in the world and Norway's national sanctuary built over St. Olav's burial site.
Striking modern church built in 1965, famous for its dramatic triangular architecture and stained glass.
World-famous ski jumping hill offering panoramic views of Oslo and the surrounding fjord.
Main base camp and starting point for the famous hike to the Pulpit Rock cliff overlooking Lysefjorden.
Maritime museum dedicated to Norwegian polar exploration, built around the historic wooden ship Fram.
Norway's largest remaining triple-nave stave church dating back to the early 13th century.
Funicular railway transporting passengers to the top of Mount Fløyen for sweeping views of Bergen.
Living history museum featuring the world's largest reconstructed Viking chieftain's longhouse.
